inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training: Primary caregiver had 20 of the 30 training hours required for training year 8/3/2025-8/3/2026 at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Pet Vaccinations: At the time of inspection, the operation did not have documentation showing the dogs vaccination record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Pet Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.801(6))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required Special Topics without specific hours: Primary caregiver did not have training for 747.1309 (D5) and (D6) at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required Special Topics without specific hours (26 TAC §747.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Statement of Health from Veterinarian: At the time of inspection, the operation did not have statement of health for the dog in the home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Statement of Health from Veterinarian (26 TAC §747.3703(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: 2 children's file did not have required admission information at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization (26 TAC §747.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File: An infant in care did not have a health statement on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File (26 TAC §747.611(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: Primary caregiver left JPS employee alone with children while she went to the store. JPS employee does not have a background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge: Primary caregiver left JPS employee in charge of the children while primary caregiver went to the store. JPS caregiver does not have a background check.This was corrected at inspection by pimary caregiver coming back to the residence.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge (26 TAC §747.203)

occurrences.finding: Smoke Detectors Testing: Last documented smoke detector test was dated for 4/2023. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke Detectors Testing (26 TAC §747.5115)

occurrences.finding: Electric or Battery Operated CO System-Test Monthly: Last documented carbon monoxide test was dated for 4/2023. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electric or Battery Operated CO System-Test Monthly (26 TAC §747.5337(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: Operation did not complete a June 2023 fire drill. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Use Disposable Gloves: Caregiver did not  discard gloves after each diaper change and wash your hands with soap and running water. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Use Disposable Gloves (26 TAC §747.3307(c))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures- Sanitizing the Diapering Area: Caregiver did not sanitize the diapering-changing surface after each use. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures- Sanitizing the Diapering Area (26 TAC §747.3307(d))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Routinely Present During Operating Hours: Primary caregiver is not routinely present at the childcare home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Routinely Present During Operating Hours (26 TAC §747.205)

occurrences.finding: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions: The operation allowed a caregiver with a provisional background check to be left at the operation alone with children unsupervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions (26 TAC §745.635(3))

occurrences.finding: Caregiver Handwashing After Diapering a Child: Caregiver did not wash hands before changing another child. This was corrected at inspection by having the caregiver wash her hands.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Caregiver Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §747.3211(4))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: Caregiver did not wash the children's hands after diapering. This was corrected at inspection by washing the children's hands.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §747.3213(3))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Use and Clean According to Manufacturer's Instructions: The substitute caregiver placed a child in play yard with no mattress. There was cardboard and board of wood under the sheet. The play yard did not have manufactures mattress.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Use and Clean According to Manufacturer's Instructions (26 TAC §747.2311(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Safe Sleep for Infants: There is no safe sleep policy in operational policies.

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Instructions for Contacting Licensing Office/Online and TX Abuse & Neglect Hotline: Policies lacked instructions on how a parent may contact the local Licensing office, access the Texas Abuse and Neglect Hotline, and access the HHSC website.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Instructions for Contacting Licensing Office/Online and TX Abuse & Neglect Hotline (26 TAC §747.501(11))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Procedures for Parents Review Licensing Rules and Reports (26 TAC §747.501(10))
